name: Postoffice Simplenews
description: Mail plugin that sends Simplenews newsletters through Symfony Mailer via the Postoffice module.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 The Postoffice module sends themed emails with Symfony Mailer .

 This module provides a mail plugin for simplenews compatibility.

 
 For a full description of the module, visit the project page 
 To submit bug reports and feature suggestions, or track changes, visit the issue tracker 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires Postoffice and Simplenews 

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit the Installing Modules documentation page for further information. 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 
 
 Setup postoffice_simplenews_mail as the mail plugin for mails sent by simplenews:

 drush config:set system.mail interface.simplenews postoffice_simplenews_mail 
 
 Back to top 

 See Also 
 This module is geared towards developers. If it does not suit your modus operandi, please have a look at the Symfony Mailer module.

 Back to top
